cli.explain.fault: One fault, a refused spot check or an error you flag, sends the type back down: a low-stakes reversible type at T3 drops to T2 (already at T2, its score decides between T2 and T1); every other fault sends it to T1. At medium or high stakes the next climb is 25% longer.
cli.explain.footer: The guarantee covers the errors you would refuse when asked; an error nobody would notice cannot be counted. Measured against theory by simulation in the test suite.
cli.explain.guarantee_title: What it guarantees, with your settings (errors you catch never run: a refused action is blocked):
cli.explain.level: {level}: {n} in a row. For an agent whose error rate is stable, errors that run without your approval stay under {aoql} of its actions of that type. For an agent that turns bad after tenure, at most {worst} until the first caught error.
cli.explain.new_model: A new model starts with half of the previous model's series, marked provisional until it confirms it (strict mode: an empty record).
cli.explain.new_model_strict: A new model starts with an empty record (strict mode).
cli.explain.reads: Reads never ask; secrets, the agent's own skills and plugins, and sensitive files always ask.
cli.explain.t1: T1 asks first. Every action of a new type asks you.
cli.explain.t1_trusted: Trusted start (default): files, memory, subagents and known local dev tools ask nothing until their first fault (an undo, a flag, a failed check, a refusal), and earn nothing meanwhile. Then T1 asks first, for that type only, and the rule below applies. Everything else starts at T1.
cli.explain.t2: T2 acts, then tells you. After {low} approved in a row at low stakes, {medium} at medium, a reversible type acts and tells you, with an undo ({command}). High stakes and irreversible types never get T2.
cli.explain.t3: T3 acts on its own. After the run of approved actions in a row given below for its stakes, over at least {sessions} sessions; 1 action in {spot} is still spot-checked at random. Dodge's continuous sampling plan CSP-1 sets the length of the run.

cli.usage:
status [--profile P] [--model M] [--all]   what each agent has earned, per action type
    setup [careful|balanced|fast]              the three recommendations; with a name, use it
    explain                                    how tenure decides, and what the numbers guarantee
    models [--type T]                          each model's verified record on your own work
    undo [ID]                                  put back the files of an action that acted, then told you (counts a fault); alone, the list
    flag TYPE [note] [--model M]               report an error the agent made on its own: its tenure is revoked
    revoke TYPE|all [--model M | --all]        take earned autonomy back without an error
    passport [--agent A] [--out FILE]          write the signed passport of an agent (--no-redact keeps type names)
    verify PASSPORT [LEDGER]                   check a passport; with the exported ledger, recompute it by replay
    anchor                                     one line to publish: the ledger's head, date and length
    export [PATH]                              write the evidence ledger (hash-chained JSON lines)
    start trusted|probation                    trusted: no question before a type's first mistake; probation: the study's start
    strict on|off                              strict mode: a new model starts with an empty record
    cleanup                                    list dead tenure keys in Hermes' permanent allowlist
